|errata_history={{Card errata/Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre}}
This is the original printing printed text of [[Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published (21 December 2021). The current text is [[Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre (Errata)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026). (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026: the later card-size copies of this image are no longer listed as separate versions; see the version list.)
* '''Original''' (this page): '''First published 20 December 2021''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f54fd7f7220526489ac0bc6fe4a71a89ca75069 commit 6f54fd7]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Virtual Set 17 release; card image first published 21 December 2021<ref name="img-2021-12-21-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.gif</code> as published 21 December 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.gif holotable commit 8190af8] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: Light: Deploys only as a starting location. There Is Another does not cause [Reflections II] Luke to be lost. If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, ▼ Like My Father Before Me.” This image was first published on 20 December 2021 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f54fd7f7220526489ac0bc6fe4a71a89ca75069 commit 6f54fd7]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E1) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre (Errata)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Card image published 12 December 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set17Type.html Virtual Set 17 card list]<ref name="img-2022-12-12-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.gif</code> as published 12 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.gif holotable commit 12d0bca] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: Light: If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, ▼ Like My Father Before Me. If Anakin 'communing,' you may initiate battles for free.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Light Side text “Deploys only as a starting location. There Is Another does not cause [Reflections II] Luke to be lost. If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, ▼ Like My Father Before Me.” became “If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, ▼ Like My Father Before Me. If Anakin 'communing,' you may initiate battles for free.”.
